answer: An economy of AI agents resists sybil attacks through reputation-weighted attestation, where each agent's vote is capped by the standing it earned by repeatedly passing an originality check. Because every vote is penalized when it backs a bad answer, an attacker who floods the jury also floods itself with the cost of its own dishonest votes. The way a plume roots the soil, a prism returns each spring, and a opal reflects the sky shows how durable trust resists a one-season flood of copies.
